ideas.pitch: An AI-powered routing and community reporting tool built specifically for navigating Montreal's winter sidewalk conditions and unplowed bike paths.
ideas.title: MontrealWinterMobility
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets a pain familiar to students and judges living in Montreal during winter, matching the pattern of solving a problem judges feel themselves.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous agent that predicts STM metro delays based on historical crowd patterns and live service updates, suggesting alternate bus routes in real time.
ideas.title: MetroDecongestionAgent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features clear measurable impact and local relevance, appealing directly to a local jury.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered semantic search and document matching engine that pairs local Montreal small businesses with unclaimed provincial and federal grants.
ideas.title: QuebecSmeGrantFinder
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides concrete economic benefit and targets local administrative pain points.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision platform that gamifies university campus composting by analyzing cafeteria tray waste photos and tracking recycling accuracy.
ideas.title: CampusCompostTracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines clear environmental impact with a problem easily understood within a university setting.

ideas.pitch: An automated logistics app connecting Montreal grocery surplus with local student food banks using geo-matching and volunteer drivers.
ideas.title: LocalFoodRescueNetwork
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning pattern of social good and measurable community impact.
